pattern: ても知らない（てもしらない）
purpose: Warn that someone must accept an unwelcome consequence.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
give explain a reason cause result
express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
If you run like that and fall, do not say I did not warn you.
If you do not save it and it disappears, you were warned.
Go out dressed that lightly and catch a cold, and do not blame me.
restrictions: The speaker disclaims responsibility for a foreseeable result.
mistake: It is stronger and less polite than simply offering advice.
